argument: Signals first, then the tiered plan. Three findings are real; the remainder of the chapter recomputes clean and should not be re-opened. (a) MECHANICAL: [08-disciplines:23] prints the singular Blade where the taxonomy row [08-disciplines:40] and ch05 both use Blades; expected value Blades, minimal fix is the word. [08-disciplines:103] promises a brand new discipline for each progression pick, but [08-disciplines:261] spends the level-3 pick deepening Fire; expected value is one rank usable in a new or an existing discipline, so reword 103 to match 99 and 261. (b) SUBSTANTIVE: [08-disciplines:107] credits a Fire-rank grant to a blade that ch17 files as requiring one Fire; the card that actually grants it is a Fire Opal and attunement, not wielding, is the condition, so swap the example name and the wording. [08-disciplines:133] folds skill into the discipline-gated ladder and maps Novice to one rank, contradicting the exemptions at [08-disciplines:15] and [08-disciplines:113] (skills) and the no-prereq basics at [08-disciplines:214]; expected value is spells and abilities plus a basics carve-out. [08-disciplines:263] states the Master fire effect as prose damage-per-round; expected value is the locked named-condition form, which ch11:134 gives as Burning 2. (c) DESIGN, needs Bruce: [08-disciplines:248] prints the Novice attribute-scaled base as 1/2/3, which the stated budget-minus-three rule cannot yield from a 2/4/6 tier; 1/2/3 is the ch09 Basic floor, so either scope the minus-three to the upper tiers or add a floor clause. VERIFIED CORRECT, do not re-investigate: taxonomy totals (nine categories, twenty-three rows) and their names match ch05, ch21 and ch22; all nine class starting sets match ch05; flat card costs 2/4/8 and the four rank ladders 1/2/4 through 4/8/16 match ch05; every worked total recomputes, including the already-holds-rank-one case; prereq shapes, the three-rank cap and the level 3 and 7 gates hold; the damage table is flat with zero dice; weapon entry combos match ch15; the skills exemption matches ch07; no em-dashes and no doubled reference periods; typst structure is clean (single fence, named callout bodies, all seven tables outlined false); all six cross-reference targets resolve. The figure offset and the sentence-initial Depth after the creation reference are deliberate conventions, not faults.
